incidents.name: wrsETH market priced by a faulty Chainlink RSETH/ETH feed
incidents.notes: Moonwell's code worked as written: the Chainlink RSETH/ETH aggregator behind the ChainlinkCompositeOracle returned an absurd rate, so a dust deposit into the mwrsETH market was valued in the millions and Comptroller.borrowAllowed let the attacker borrow wstETH and other assets against it.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim is the mwrsETH MErc20Delegator 0xfC41B49d064Ac646015b459C522820DB9472F4B5 (creator 0x29b28b0ff5b6b26448f3ac02cd209539626d96ab, not the attacker); its comptroller 0xfBb21d0380beE3312B33c4353c8936a0F13EF26C prices it through ChainlinkOracle 0xEC942bE8A8114bFD0396A5052c36027f2cA6a9d0 -> ChainlinkCompositeOracle 0xCcC994A46c0d81c934FD6C82D89F626Aee336ADE -> RSETH/ETH feed 0xd7221b10FBBC1e1ba95Fd0B4D031C15f7F365296; distinct incident and distinct contract from the 2026-02 cbETH row in this file

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. MErc20Delegator: implementation lives at storage slot 19 (slot 18 is `underlying`), held 0x1fadff493529c3fcc7ee04f1f15d19816dda45b7 continuously over a 25-point probe of [20948090, 37722882], and the only NewImplementation(address,address) event on the delegator is the 0x0 -> 0x1fadff49 write in the creation block 20948090. callTracer on the exploit tx shows the delegator delegatecalling only 0x1fadff49..., whose own runtime has no reachable DELEGATECALL.

incidents.name: Moonwell
incidents.notes: Moonwell's cbETH Chainlink oracle reported a faulty cbETH price, letting the attacker liquidate a borrow and arbitrage the difference against Aerodrome's real price.
